notes.content:
Compatible with Steamdeck screen size

Changes to save data specifications
　Pressing "Exit" from the menu will save the game.

notes.title: M.C 0.0.007
notes.content: Fixed a bug in nameplate chromakey mode

The chromakey name has been changed to magenta.
The option to turn the chromakey on and off has been added to the save data.
The option to show or hide the cat's name has been added to the save data items.

*Data from before 0.0.005 will be initialized once.

Fixed some names becoming fixed when adjusting the maximum number of cats
Locked the upper limit of the maximum number of cats when not linked to chat
Fixed the color of the shadow cast by the white cat
Mute the BGM volume to hide the BGM UI
